title: Dependency Accordion: sprint-anchor visibility & preflight handoffs
creator: Priya Menon
summary: Create a lightweight "accordion" pattern in the Console roadmap view that surfaces per-sprint dependency anchors, preflight handoff checklists, and an escalation lane so PMs can clearly see, act on, and automate cross-team dependencies (Engineering, Design, Security, Infra) during planning and cutovers.
background: We frequently observe missed assumptions during handoffs (design assets not final, infra capacity not reserved, security signoff delayed). Current roadmap notes are free-text and buried; teams want an actionable, time-boxed surface that ties to sprint anchors and triggers runbook steps. This ticket scopes a product + UX + automation deliverable to reduce dependency regressions across the next two quarters.
goals: Make cross-team dependencies visible at sprint level with explicit owners and due windows
Provide a preflight checklist that teams can mark complete and that gates cutover readiness
Automate escalation when a critical dependency is not progressing to avoid last-minute firefighting
Emit telemetry to the dependency dashboard for downstream OKR and cadence reviews
acceptance_criteria: Console roadmap shows a collapsed 'Dependency Accordion' per sprint that expands to list dependencies with owner, status, expected handoff date, and blocking label
Preflight checklist items are configurable per dependency and persist as part of the issue; checklist completion updates a readiness flag
Automated escalation rule (configurable) creates an alert/ticket to slack #incubator and pings oncall when a P0 dependency misses the handoff window
Dependency-level events are emitted to telemetry pipeline and visible in the dependency dashboard with filters for team, severity, and cycle
Design review and Security signoff flows are integrated (links to design spec and security checklist) and can be required before marking 'Ready for Cutover'
out_of_scope: Full-blown dependency SLA marketplace (won't include multi-org purchasing flows)
Automated retries for failed infra provisioning (manual hook via infra playbook)
Historical dependency scoring engine (telemetry forward-looking only for this phase)
tasks: PM: finalize checklist template and escalation matrix (Priya)
Design: wireframes for accordion and checklist interactions + accessibility pass (Ava)
Eng: API contract for dependency objects, readiness flags, and telemetry events (Marco)
Infra: define webhook and reservation API for capacity anchors (Sana)
Security: define security signoff checklist and required gating conditions (Jordan)
Analytics: add dashboard queries and a dependency health view (Data Eng)
Docs: runbook for responders and how to configure escalation windows
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Too many checklist items will cause fatigue -> Mitigation: limit to 5 high-value items and allow templates
Risk: Escalation noise if thresholds misconfigured -> Mitigation: default to conservative (only P0) and make window configurable per project
Risk: Sensitive security artifacts linked in console could leak -> Mitigation: integrate RBAC and honor VPC/private flags; security review required
